title: Face moves
intro: Faces move the headset and the lids. Keep looking at the dot while you make each face. The microphone isn't recorded.

steps.text: Keep looking at the dot and do what it says.
Read this aloud while looking at the dot as much as you can:|"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, then naps in the warm afternoon sun."
Smile and keep smiling. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
